data.name: schedule_entry_completed_session_on_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER schedule_entry_completed_session_on_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON schedule_entry
WHEN NEW.status = 'completed_by_session'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM session
    WHERE id = NEW.session_id
      AND schedule_entry_id = NEW.id
      AND workout_id = NEW.workout_id
      AND status = 'finished'
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'completed schedule must reference its finished session');
END;

data.name: schedule_entry_completed_session_on_update
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER schedule_entry_completed_session_on_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF status, session_id, workout_id ON schedule_entry
WHEN NEW.status = 'completed_by_session'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM session
    WHERE id = NEW.session_id
      AND schedule_entry_id = NEW.id
      AND workout_id = NEW.workout_id
      AND status = 'finished'
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'completed schedule must reference its finished session');
END;

data.name: session_completed_schedule_status_on_update
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER session_completed_schedule_status_on_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF status, workout_id ON session
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM schedule_entry
  WHERE session_id = OLD.id
    AND status = 'completed_by_session'
)
  AND (
    NEW.status <> 'finished'
    OR NEW.workout_id IS NOT OLD.workout_id
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot invalidate completed schedule session link');
END;
